migration.description: Add durable prepared-archive recovery state, a resumable legacy archive reconciliation cursor, and additive raw-capture circuit state over the bounded physical inventory.
migration.release_unit_description: Autonomous retention recovery and raw capture circuit breaker.

durable_state.description: Prepared archive identity, source IDs and digest over all archive-covered columns, artifact digest/size, bounded retry/quarantine state, legacy reconciliation cursor, startup raw-path revalidation cursor, recovery-pending hysteresis marker, and additive raw-capture circuit measurements including overflow-spool bytes.
durable_state.storage_implementation: SQLite tables retention_prepared_archives and retention_recovery_cursors plus additive circuit and overflow-spool columns on system_raw_payload_metrics.

source_compatibility_range.from_program_versions: Supported earlier v2.71.x database schemas without retention recovery tables.

ddl_structural_changes.description: Idempotently create retention_prepared_archives, its path/due-work indexes, retention_recovery_cursors with the legacy scan cursor, and raw-capture circuit plus overflow-spool columns on system_raw_payload_metrics.

dml_changes.description: Insert and update only bounded prepared archive, retry, quarantine, and cursor rows during normal maintenance.

historical_data_backfill_or_transformati.description: No startup-wide historical backfill; legacy archive reconciliation advances at most 32 archive files and raw inventory advances at most 128 DB references per maintenance pass.

progress_signals: retentionRecovery prepared/quarantined/backlog counts, stage, last progress, next retry, and failure fingerprint
rawCapture state/reason, physical raw bytes, filesystem available bytes, fixed close/recovery watermarks, bounded reservations, and backlog trend
pause_points: Between idempotent schema creation and maintenance-owned ledger writes.
Between each maintenance pass of at most 32 legacy archive files and 128 raw inventory references.

recovery.program_rollback_state_behavior: Earlier binaries ignore the additive recovery tables and raw-capture columns; they do not reverse or delete their state.
recovery.faulty_release_recovery: A newer program version resumes or forward-repairs retained journal rows and quarantined artifacts.

required_test_evidence: Public system-status API change is additive and optional for older clients.
Raw-capture circuit hydration, hysteresis, fail-closed unknown states, bounded reservations, and inventory reset pass stateful SQLite and focused raw-capture regression tests.
